summary.topic: A conceptual Hyperloop capsule in a test track
summary.learning_goal: Show capsule movement and its relation to tube infrastructure.
summary.primary_visualization: Long capsule and track with a selectable surrounding tube and live speed readout.
summary.primary_interaction: Demo starts a run, changes camera, changes time factor and tube visibility.

strengths: The panel explicitly calls the trip data a demonstration rather than real operating performance.
weaknesses: Speed and position calculations were not independently checked.

strengths: Tube visibility exposes the relationship between vehicle and enclosing infrastructure.
weaknesses: The recording provides little explanation of levitation, propulsion, pressure or energy use.

strengths: Longitudinal framing makes capsule, track and support structure readable.
weaknesses: Pale tube and pale background reduce separation of nested surfaces.

strengths: Recorded control changes coincide with camera shifts, elapsed-time changes and visible tube state.
weaknesses: The apparent high-speed values do not prove a physically meaningful model; live response remains untested.

strengths: Large title, dominant capsule and aligned data panel give a clear product hierarchy.
weaknesses: Low contrast is partly due to the recording, so original-page legibility is uncertain.

top_strengths: Tube visibility exposes the relationship between vehicle and enclosing infrastructure.
Longitudinal framing makes capsule, track and support structure readable.
Large title, dominant capsule and aligned data panel give a clear product hierarchy.
top_weaknesses: Speed and position calculations were not independently checked.
The recording provides little explanation of levitation, propulsion, pressure or energy use.
The apparent high-speed values do not prove a physically meaningful model; live response remains untested.
principles_to_learn: Expose enclosing structures with controlled visibility.
Keep motion readouts adjacent to the moving object.
Separate time scaling from claims about physical speed.
things_not_to_copy: Do not confuse an animated test track with validated engineering.
Do not sacrifice nested-surface contrast for an all-white aesthetic.
golden_recommendation: Provisional demo reference. Use for simulation playback, visibility control, camera tracking. Live behavior remains unverified.
